descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S23 Cards on phone width (Pixel 7 Chromium, iPhone 15 WebKit) and the Android app

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Each patient renders as a card on the home screen showing the patient's first and last name and room (Nursing Home: unit/room). (UAT TC-01; TFA-92579 AC 3)
  • U2 The card shows the chief diagnosis on Hospital cards only; a Nursing Home card shows no diagnosis. (UAT TC-01; TFA-92579 AC 3; UAT TC-03)
  • U3 The card shows age/sex in the "76F" format. (UAT TC-01; TFA-92579 AC 3)
  • U4 The card shows the New Admission / Follow-up / Consult badge. (UAT TC-01; TFA-92579 AC 3)
  • U5 The card shows the hospital day (Hospital) or the visit number (Nursing Home). (UAT TC-01; TFA-92579 AC 3)
  • T5 A patient card can be removed by tapping its trash icon; a pop-up designed like the app UI tells the user what happens if they delete, and the user presses Cancel or OK. (TFA-92579 AC 7)

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Visual lane profiles pixel7 and iphone15; android-lane on the emulator

When Open both lists

Then Name, room, diagnosis, badge and day/visit number are not truncated, covered or overflowing; the trash icon is a separate tap target of at least 24 px

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): visual-lane findings covered/overflow/truncated/tap = 0 on the list screens; findings go to a human (vision-review.sh)

Where it ran: dev; test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (automated)

S23 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-01.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); secondary: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both (web widths); Source: dev.
